name: Centro de Meditación Kadampa Córdoba
tradition: New Kadampa Tradition (NKT-IKBU), Gelug-derived Modern Kadampa Buddhism
technique: Lamrim-based analytical and placement meditation, guided meditation, and mantra recitation, following the teachings of Geshe Kelsang Gyatso
influences: New Kadampa Tradition - International Kadampa Buddhist Union (NKT-IKBU)
teacherAccess: Resident teacher Kelsang Atisha and visiting NKT teachers give teachings and lead guided meditation sessions during residential retreats, with dedicated Q&A time.
retreatOptions: Weekly non-residential classes and weekend courses at the Córdoba city center; periodic 3-4 night residential retreats (e.g. purification, Tomar y Dar, and deity-practice retreats) held at a rented retreat house in Villa Allende.
about: Centro de Meditación Kadampa Córdoba, part of the international New Kadampa Tradition (NKT-IKBU) founded by Geshe Kelsang Gyatso Rinpoche, was established in September 2014 as the second Kadampa center in Argentina after Buenos Aires. Its city-center location in Córdoba capital, led by resident monk Kelsang Atisha, runs weekly meditation classes and weekend courses on Buddhist philosophy for beginners and continuing students. Several times a year the center also runs residential retreats, typically 3-4 nights, at the Casa de Retiros Catalina de María in nearby Villa Allende, combining Lamrim teachings with up to four guided meditation sessions a day. Retreat packages include full board (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) and shared accommodation, and past themes have included purification and fasting, Tomar y Dar (taking-and-giving) practice, and deity-specific retreats such as Vajrayogini and Guru Sumati Buddha Heruka.
schedule: Weekly meditation classes and weekend courses at the city center; multi-night residential retreats (typically 3-4 nights, up to four teaching/meditation sessions per day) held several times a year in Villa Allende.
cost: Fixed, tiered registration fee per residential retreat (early-bird through standard pricing), covering teachings, meals, and shared lodging; weekly city classes are priced separately per class.

pricePerDay.notes: Retiro de Tomar y Dar (Carnaval 2026), 3 nights at Casa de Retiros Catalina de María, Villa Allende: ARS $330,000 (early-bird, until 16 Jan) to $380,000 (from 7 Feb), covering teachings, meals and lodging, divided by 3 nights.

foodNotes: Full board (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) included in residential retreat packages; specific dietary style not published.
